offer.text: Evening prayers ran long and now the dark presses close. Walk with me and keep the wicked things at bay — I'll lead us home to my own bed.

accept.text: Blessings upon you. Stay near and fear nothing.

decline.text: Then I'll trust to faith and a quick step. Go in peace.

in_progress.text: Not far now. Keep the shadows from our heels.

ready.text: My own threshold, thank the light. We're home.

complete.text: You guarded a humble servant through the dark. That is its own blessing — and here is mine to you.
